# teams_byod_and_desks_policy (Resource)

Manages the BYODAndDesksPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy / Get-CsTeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy / Set-CsTeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy.
